professionalSummary.text: Built and maintained SQL/Python pipelines for ingesting card-scheme settlement files and ledger extracts into a reconciliation warehouse on Snowflake, using dbt models and Python pre-validation for file checksums.
professionalSummary.witness: Built the nightly loader that ingests Visa and Mastercard settlement files (TC57/T112) and the general-ledger extract into the reconciliation warehouse on Snowflake, using dbt models and a Python pre-validation step for file checksums.

experienceHighlights.text: Investigated unmatched settlement items daily with finance operations analysts, tracing exceptions to fee mismatches, timing differences, or duplicate captures, and documented root causes and resolutions in a shared exception log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Worked the daily unmatched-item queue with two finance operations analysts, tracing each exception to fee mismatches, timing differences or duplicate captures, and recorded the root cause and resolution in the shared exception log.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented data lineage, known limitations, and hand-over conditions for pipeline releases, including source files, transformation steps, and two limitations requiring manual review (partial refunds and multi-currency fees).
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the lineage notes for the matching model, listing the source files, the transformation steps and the two known limitations (partial refunds and multi-currency fees) that still needed manual review.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated pipeline changes with settlement operations and compliance teams during the monthly change window, covering loader and matching key updates, while acknowledging that go-live approval remained with the finance engineering lead.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented pipeline changes at the monthly change-window review with settlement operations and compliance; my part covered the loader and the matching keys, while approval of the go-live date stayed with the finance engineering lead.
